verdict.label: Heavy review / verification
verdict.summary: Microsoft Entra ID requires bringing your own OAuth app, configuring explicit multi-tenant settings and redirect URIs, and completing Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Program verification for production trust.

composioFit.summary: A Composio-managed OAuth app is not available for Microsoft Entra ID (MICROSOFT_ENTRA_ID), so you must bring your own OAuth app.

phases.name: Register Application
steps: Sign in to the Microsoft Entra admin center as at least an Application Developer.
Browse to Entra ID > App registrations and select New registration.
Enter a meaningful Name for your app.
Select supported account types (recommended: Multiple Entra ID tenants for SaaS).

phases.name: Configure Redirect URIs and Scopes
steps: Add redirect URIs matching your production requirements.
Set a publisher domain in Branding & properties.
Request necessary delegated or application permissions.

phases.name: Publisher Verification
steps: Ensure your organization has a verified Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Program (CPP) Partner Global Account (PGA).
Navigate to Branding & properties in App registrations.
Select Add Partner ID to verify publisher and enter your Partner One ID.

artefacts.title: Microsoft Entra App Registration Values
artefacts.body:
Name: identity-client-app
Supported account types: Multiple Entra ID tenants
Redirect URI: <Composio callback URL from your auth config>

requirements.label: Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Program Account
Publisher Domain Configuration
requirements.when: Required if aiming for publisher verification and removing unverified warnings

scopes.purpose: Sign in and read user profile
Writing data to an organization's directory

redirectRules.rule: Redirect URIs must begin with the scheme https, with exceptions for some localhost redirect URIs.
Redirect URIs are case-sensitive and must match the case of the URL path of your running application.
The maximum number of redirect URIs is 256 for Microsoft work or school accounts in any organization's Microsoft Entra tenant.

blockers.symptom: AADSTS50011: The reply URL specified in the request does not match the reply URLs configured for the application.
blockers.cause: The redirect URI specified in the login request does not match any registered redirect URIs.
blockers.fix: Add the exact redirect URI to your app registration.
blockers.fallback: Check for trailing slashes and case sensitivity.

blockers.symptom: AADSTS70011: The provided value for the input parameter 'scope' is not valid.
blockers.cause: An invalid scope format or ungranted scope was requested.
blockers.fix: Ensure the scope string uses the correct resource identifier URI prefix.
blockers.fallback: Verify application permissions in the Entra admin center.

blockers.symptom: Access to XMLHttpRequest from origin has been blocked by CORS policy.
blockers.cause: Attempting to use the authorization code flow without setting up CORS for your redirect URI or missing SPA platform configuration.
blockers.fix: Configure CORS and ensure redirect URI is marked as a spa redirect URI if applicable.
blockers.fallback: Use standard web platform redirect configuration.

checklist.text: Sign in to the Microsoft Entra admin center as an Application Developer.
Register a new application with appropriate account types.
Configure redirect URIs matching HTTPS and loopback rules.
Set up a publisher domain and verify via microsoft-identity-association.json if needed.
Associate a verified Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Program Partner Global Account for publisher verification.

uncertainties: Exact custom review duration by Microsoft beyond the standard 3 to 5 business days for Partner Center verification.

claims.text: Microsoft Entra ID custom app integration requires Partner Global Account verification and scope configuration, placing it at difficulty level 4.
claims.reason: Derived from the combination of app registration, publisher domain configuration, and CPP verification requirements.

claims.text: First test token can be obtained within 15 to 30 minutes after registration.
claims.reason: App registration and basic auth code flow configuration can be completed quickly.

claims.text: Production readiness including partner verification takes 3 to 5 business days.
